main.description: Record of a play session for a game, optionally including a review. Fields describe what happened during this session, not the resulting play state. Who can comment is controlled by a social.respawn.feed.replygate record with the same rkey.

edition.description: Edition of the game this session was played on.

dlc.description: Expansions or DLC included in this session.

finishedPlaying.description: This session ended the playthrough, with this outcome. Absent means still playing (or no progress change).

media.description: Grain (grain.social) photos shown with the log.

review.description: A review attached to a log.

text.description: Display text. Spans marked with a spoiler facet are scrambled here; naive clients can render this field safely.

textWithSpoilers.description: Original text with spoiler spans unscrambled. Only present when the review contains spoiler facets.

containsSpoilers.description: Whole-review spoiler flag. Clients hide the review text until revealed, unless the viewer has the game in their collection with a completed play state.

media.description: A Grain photo shown with a log, credited to the gallery it was picked from.

photo.description: A social.grain.photo record in the log author's repo.

gallery.description: The social.grain.gallery the photo was picked from. Grain has no page for a single photo, so this is what the credit links to.

external.description: Reference to an external document (e.g. standard.site) holding the full review.
